description: Explains how to buy a 7-day pass (5 USDC) for a wallet. Recommended: x402 at POST https://agentsla.io/v1/pass (one USDC signature, no gas, no approval). Alternative: the returned unsigned Base Mainnet transactions (a USDC approve, only if its allowance is below 5 USDC, then paySubscription() on the escrow contract). Use it when check_pass shows no active pass. Calling it is free and changes nothing: the wallet signs and sends the returned transactions itself (gas in ETH on Base); AgentSLA holds no keys and moves no funds. Buying while a pass is active extends it by 7 days from its current expiry. Returns the ordered transactions (to, data, value, chainId) and warnings such as an insufficient USDC balance.

walletAddress.description: Base Mainnet wallet that will sign, pay for and own the pass, e.g. "0x1234...abcd".

name: buy_pass
title: Buy a 7-day pass
